import io

import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "foo": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        "bar": [6.0, 7.5, 8.25, 9.0, 10.75],
        "ham": ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"],
    }
)

df.write_parquet(buffer)
